cases.name: Linda Rose Troncelliti Perkins
cases.about: She was active in actor Clint Eastwood's successful 1985 mayoral campaign, a member of the Junior League, and volunteered at several nearby schools. She was also a key organizer of Carmel's legendary Mummers parties.
cases.narrative: On 7/21/1989, she was found bludgeoned to death in her driveway. She was hit in the head 7 times with a metal baseball bat and beaten beyond recognition. The attack was so vicious it knocked her out of her shoes. fractured her skull. crushed bones in her eye sockets and face, and detached the tip of her nose and one of her ears.
